note: Which data-store@1 keys move onto axf-data's Postgres rows, group by group (framework/spec/DATA-INVENTORY.md, build postgres-part-c-console-state-settings). Run by framework/cli/data-cut.mjs: copy (backfill) → verify (every key's content equal on both sides, read back from its rows; row counts per table) → cutover (flip the entries with flip: true to key-level cutover, data-store-mode@1 keys). An entry is one key (`key`) or every key under a prefix (`prefix`, ends in '/'). `flip: false` = a writer outside the data layer still writes the file (a shell installer, axHub's files API, claude-sync): the key is kept equal on axf-data by `data-cut sync` (cron) and named in `why`, and flips once that writer goes through the data layer. `writers` lists every writer the flip depends on. `table` is the Postgres table (services/axf-data/tables.py) the rows land in.

console.title: Console state, settings, alerts, notifications, home cards, token log, notes, control inventory, AmberX notes, app catalog
